title: Glen Beck and Betty Snyder program the ENIAC in building 328 at the Ballistic Research Laboratory.jpg

title: Two women operating ENIAC (full resolution).jpg
desc: Two of the ENIAC programmers, are preparing the computer for Demonstration Day in February 1946. "U.S. Army Photo" from the archives of the ARL Technical Library. Left: Betty Jennings (Mrs. Bartik), right: Frances Bilas (Mrs. Spence).
